details: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest recently offloaded approximately $14 million in Circle shares and reduced its holdings in Coinbase. This move occurred during a period where other crypto-related stocks were experiencing a rally. Additionally, the firm sold about $40 million of its own Ark 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB).
title: Ark Invest Sells $14M in Circle, Trims Coinbase as Crypto Stocks Rally

details: The cryptocurrency exchange CoinEx has announced its decision to cease operations after nine years in the market, attributing the shutdown to a prolonged market downturn. This news contributed to a 3.4% intraday price swing for Kaspa.
title: Crypto Exchange CoinEx to Shut Down After 9 Years, Citing Market Slump

details: The decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol Balancer has put forth a proposal to wind down its operations and distribute its treasury assets, estimated at over $9 million, to holders of its native BAL token. This follows the closure of Balancer Labs six months prior, prompted by a $128 million exploit in 2025.
title: Balancer Proposes Protocol Wind-Down, Treasury Distribution to BAL Holders

details: The U.S. Department of Justice has filed a civil forfeiture complaint aiming to seize approximately $61 million in cryptocurrency. These funds are alleged to be proceeds from black-market Iranian oil sales that were laundered through Binance accounts by two China-based companies.
title: US DOJ Seeks $61 Million in Crypto From Illicit Iranian Oil Laundered on Binance

details: Tonkeeper, a prominent wallet within The Open Network (TON) ecosystem, has rebranded to Keeper. The rebrand includes expanded support for multiple blockchain networks, now encompassing Bitcoin, Ethereum, and others, with an ambition to become a leading self-custodial wallet for a multichain environment.
title: Tonkeeper Rebrands to Keeper, Adds Bitcoin and Ethereum Support

details: The proposed CLARITY Act, a key piece of U.S. cryptocurrency regulation, is facing significant hurdles as opposition has broadened. Banks, Democrats, state attorneys general, and developer advocates have rejected crucial compromises in the "final" draft, raising uncertainty ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.
title: CLARITY Act Deal Breaking Down Ahead of Crucial Senate Vote

details: Bitcoin's price edged lower, dropping below $77,000, as investors awaited a critical U.S. Senate vote on the CLARITY Act. This decline also reflects caution in the market ahead of the Federal Reserve's anticipated decision on interest rates.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $77k Ahead of Clarity Act Vote, Fed Meeting

details: Asset manager Strive has further increased its Bitcoin holdings by purchasing an additional 469 BTC for $36.6 million. This acquisition brings the firm's total Bitcoin treasury to exactly 25,000 BTC. The purchase was funded entirely through preferred stock.
title: Strive's Bitcoin Stash Hits an Even 25,000 BTC After $36.6 Million Buy

details: DeFi Development Corp, a Solana treasury firm, has added another 55,491 SOL to its balance sheet. The company has also initiated a substantial $300 million "CHAD" at-the-market program for its preferred stock, designed to fund further purchases of SOL.
title: Solana Treasury Firm Rolls Out $300M CHAD to Buy More SOL

details: Standard Chartered has begun coverage on Arbitrum, projecting that its native token, ARB, could reach $10 by the end of 2030. This forecast implies a substantial 70-fold increase from its current trading levels, with the bank also expecting ARB to outperform both Bitcoin and Ethereum over the forecast period.
title: Standard Chartered Forecasts Arbitrum (ARB) to Hit $10 by 2030
